table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= case  WHEN saleinvdetail.saleitemdescription is null THEN item.name ELSE saleinvdetail.saleitemdescription END,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	message=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode), 
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode,
	accname =customer.cp/* dbo.accounts.name*/,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,   
	city= dbo.customer.city,   
	licenceno= dbo.customer.licenceno,   
	username= dbo.users.username,   
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno, 
	headerinvno=dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,  
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	BillingDate = dbo.saleledger.BillingDate,
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	gcode = saleinvdetail.gcode,   
	icode = saleinvdetail.icode,   
	looseqty = SUM(saleinvdetail.looseqty),
	bonusqty = SUM(saleinvdetail.bonusqty),
	packunits= MAX(saleinvdetail.packunits), 
	saleprice= MAX(saleinvdetail.saleprice), 
	discperc = MAX(saleinvdetail.discperc),   
	salestax = 0,  
	itemflatdisc=MAX(saleinvdetail.itemflatdisc),   
	Id = MAX(dbo.saleinvdetail.IDENTITYCOL),   
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = MAX(saleinvdetail.unitsalestax),   
	gstperc = MAX(saleinvdetail.gstperc),   
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno2,	
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno3,	
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno4,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	salesman=ltrim(rtrim(dbo.salesman.name)),
	Message=ltrim(rtrim(dbo.Message.description)),
	manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manfcode=item.manfcode),
	CUSTALIAS=ACCOUNTS.ALIASNAME,
	DoctorName=(select D.Name from Doctors D where D.DoctCode=saleledger.DoctCode),
	patientregno=(select regno from patient where patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	patientname=(select name from patient where patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	patientaddress=(select address1 from patient where patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	InvTotal = dbo.saleledger.invtotal,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno5
FROM 
	saleledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.SalesMan ON (dbo.saleledger.smancode = dbo.salesman.salesmancode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.Message ON (dbo.saleledger.messagecode = dbo.message.messagecode),
	saleinvdetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode BETWEEN :ar_SInvCode AND :ar_LInvCode) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode=saleinvdetail.saleinvcode) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleinvdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    
GROUP BY
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode,
	dbo.saleledger.DoctCode,
	dbo.saleledger.headerno, 
	dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,  
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.BillingDate,
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.messagecode,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno2,	
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno3,	
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno4,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	dbo.saleledger.posted,   
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	dbo.accounts.ALIASNAME,
	dbo.customer.cp,   
	dbo.customer.address1,   
	dbo.customer.address2,   
	dbo.customer.city,   
	dbo.customer.licenceno,   
	dbo.customer.salestaxregno,
	dbo.users.username,   
	dbo.item.name,   
	dbo.item.customicode,
	dbo.saleinvdetail.saleitemdescription,
	dbo.item.packingdesc,   
	dbo.item.manfcode,
	dbo.saleinvdetail.gcode,   
	dbo.saleinvdetail.icode,   
	dbo.salesman.name,
	dbo.Message.description,
	dbo.saleledger.invtotal,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno5
ORDER BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	dbo.item.name

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: ( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc) * ( 1 - (discperc * .01 ) ) ) + ( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc) * ( 1 - (discperc * .01 ) ) * gstperc * 0.01) + (unitsalestax * looseqty)

objects.name: t_7
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc) * ( 1 - (discperc * .01 ) ) * gstperc * 0.01) + (unitsalestax * looseqty) for group 1) = 0, 0, 1)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_invdiscount
objects.expression: ROUND(SUM( ( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc) * ( 1 - (discperc * .01 ) ) ) for group 1) * ( invdiscperc * .01) , 2)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: SUM( ( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc) * ( 1 - (discperc * .01 ) ) ) + ( looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc) * ( 1 - (discperc * .01 ) ) * gstperc * 0.01) + (unitsalestax * looseqty) for group 1)
